name: Nankhatai
description: Soft, crumbly shortbread biscuits with a hint of cardamom — the way your grandmother remembers them.
ingredients: Refined wheat flour (maida), sugar, butter, vanaspati, milk solids, cardamom, baking powder and a pinch of salt.
allergens: Contains wheat and milk. May contain traces of nuts.
storage: Keep in an airtight container in a cool, dry place.
